lines.en: scene black
I knock on Makoto’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Makoto 的门，等她回应。

lines.en: scene tree3 with flash
scene bluejayredux1
And then the first scene commentary event of 2023 kicks off.
lines.zh: 然后，2023 年的第一场场景解说事件就开场了。

lines.en: : And what a fun event we’ve chosen for you this time.
lines.zh: : 而我们这次为你们挑的事件，可真有意思。

lines.en: “Bluejay” is one of many events in Lessons in Love that threw the game’s community into chaos immediately after its release due to its...well, we’ll get there soon.
lines.zh: 《Bluejay》是《Lessons in Love》里众多「一发布就把玩家社区炸开锅」的事件之一，因为它的……嗯，我们很快会讲到。

lines.en: But even today, three years and roughly two million words down the line, it’s still widely regarded as one of the most memorable events in the game.
lines.zh: 但即便到了今天，时隔三年、又写了大约两百万字之后，它依然被公认为游戏里最令人难忘的事件之一。

lines.en: But one thing many people probably {i}don’t{/i} know is exactly how far in advance it was planned.
lines.zh: 但有一件事很多人大概{i}并不{/i}知道：它到底提前多久就规划好了。

lines.en: Unless you’re one of the few who followed all of the signposts I laid out, that is.
lines.zh: 当然，除非你是那少数几个一路跟上了我埋下的路标的人。

lines.en: scene pornshop6r with flash
Like this one.
lines.zh: 比如这个。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’m going to kill myself tonight.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正我今晚就要自杀了。

lines.en: scene makotoroof9 with flash
Or this one.
lines.zh: 或者这个。

lines.en: : Perhaps it was something else that brought you here?
lines.zh: : 也许是别的什么东西把你带到这儿来的？

lines.en: : Maybe a hidden urge to throw yourself from the top of a building?
lines.zh: : 也许是某种隐藏的冲动，想从楼顶一跃而下？

lines.en: scene bluejayredux1 with flash
The point is, Bluejay is an event that could have been predicted. And a lot of people {i}did{/i} predict it — but that didn’t stop it from still being shocking in its own sort of...{i}happy{/i} way.
lines.zh: 重点是，《Bluejay》是一个本可以被预测到的事件。而且很多人{i}确实{/i}预测到了 —— 但这并不妨碍它在发生时依然以一种……{i}幸福的{/i}方式让人震惊。

lines.en: But we’ll never find {i}true{/i} happiness by just standing out in the hallway. So how about we head on over to where Bluejay {i}really{/i} begins?
lines.zh: 但光站在走廊里是永远找不到{i}真正{/i}的幸福的。所以，不如我们去《Bluejay》{i}真正{/i}开始的地方？

lines.en: scene bluejayredux3
: About that...I know that the rest of the crew is waiting at the bottom of the school with a trampoline for the reenactment, but I’d feel a lot better if we could maybe have it inspected or-
lines.zh: : 关于那个……我知道其他人都已经在楼下等着、架好蹦床准备重演了，但要是能先检查一下什么的，我会安心很多，或者 ——

lines.en: : We don’t have time for that, Makoto. You know how tight the budget is.
lines.zh: : 我们没时间搞那个，Makoto。你知道预算有多紧。

lines.en: : Oh, about {i}that.{/i} I reviewed the payroll documents like you asked me to and I really think you should cut Commentary Ami’s pay. She’s making five times more than the next-
lines.zh: : 哦，说到{i}那个{/i}。我按你说的看了工资单，我真的觉得你该给解说版 Ami 减薪。她的薪水比下一个人高五倍 ——

lines.en: scene bluejay1 with flash
So anyway, we’re on the roof now.
lines.zh: 总之，我们现在在天台上。

lines.en: And, all jokes aside, this is where things began to take a turn for the worse.
lines.zh: 玩笑归玩笑，就是从这里开始，事情急转直下。

lines.en: It was clear from the get-go to both Sensei and the player (If the player was paying any amount of attention) that {i}something{/i} was going on with Makoto tonight.
lines.zh: 从一开始，Sensei 和玩家（只要玩家有哪怕一丁点在留意）都很清楚：今晚 Makoto {i}有点不对劲{/i}。

lines.en: Was it just a sudden desire to be {i}bad{/i} like she mentioned in the moments prior to this? Or was it something...harder to put into words?
lines.zh: 是像她在此之前提到的那样，只是突然想{i}坏{/i}一次？还是某种……更难用语言表达的东西？

lines.en: Something she’d been {i}trying{/i} to put into words for quite some time now, only to find that the people she wanted to notice she was hurting the most didn’t take her pain seriously.
lines.zh: 某种她已经{i}试着{/i}表达很久的东西，却发现自己最想被察觉、也最伤她的那些人，并没有把她的痛苦当回事。

lines.en: I don’t even think {i}Makoto{/i} knew for sure what she was going to do by coming here.
lines.zh: 我甚至不认为{i}Makoto 自己{/i}清楚来这儿是为了做什么。

lines.en: I, as the {i}writer{/i} knew, of course...but in order to write believable characters, you need to be able to cast aside that meta knowledge and learn to get inside the heads of the people you’re writing.
lines.zh: 我作为{i}作者{/i}当然是知道的……但要写出可信的角色，你得能把这种「上帝视角」的知识放到一边，学会钻进你笔下那些人的脑子里。

lines.en: If Makoto is good at anything, it’s putting on a front.
lines.zh: 如果说 Makoto 擅长什么，那就是装。

lines.en: So while she may be smiling and smirking just minutes before deciding her fate, she’s screaming on the inside and no one can hear her.
lines.zh: 所以，即使她在决定自己命运前的几分钟里还在笑着、得意着，她的内心却在尖叫，而没有人听得见。

lines.en: scene bluejay12 with flash
Or maybe it would be more accurate to say that {i}someone{/i} just didn’t {i}want{/i} to hear her.
lines.zh: 或者更准确地说，是有{i}某个人{/i}根本就不{i}想{/i}听。

lines.en: scene bluejay27 with flash
Depression, like many other mental disorders, comes in all different sorts of flavors.
lines.zh: 抑郁症和很多其他精神疾病一样，有许多不同的「口味」。

lines.en: Up until now, the most apparent flavor of this was seen through interactions with Rin — a character whose disorder manifested in a much more visible and visceral way.
lines.zh: 到目前为止，最明显的一种是通过 Rin 呈现出来的 —— 她的病以一种更外露、更刺目的方式表现出来。

lines.en: But one person’s pain being more apparent than someone else’s doesn’t mean that first person hurts {i}more.{/i}
lines.zh: 但一个人的痛苦比另一个人更外露，并不代表前者就更{i}痛{/i}。

lines.en: Sometimes, the people who smile the hardest are the ones most desperately clinging to life.
lines.zh: 有时候，笑得最用力的人，恰恰是最拼命想要活下去的人。

lines.en: They hide the pain like injured animals...simply waiting for things to end.
lines.zh: 他们像受伤的动物一样藏起痛苦……只是等着一切结束。

lines.en: Unfortunately, humans have the ability to {i}think{/i} at levels far more complex than most animals...which leads them to making decisions that no human should {i}ever{/i} be forced to make.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，人类能{i}思考{/i}的层次远比大多数动物复杂……这也让他们做出一些本不该由任何人被迫去做的决定。

lines.en: : Close your eyes...

Some people can only stretch so far — and when they’ve exhausted every effort in their arsenal and can’t find any other means to turn things around, they have a hard time comprehending if they even {i}should.{/i}
lines.zh: 有些人只能撑到某个限度 —— 当他们用尽了手里所有办法、再也找不到扭转局面的方式时，他们很难判断自己到底还{i}该不该{/i}继续。

lines.en: It wasn’t until spending what were meant to be her final moments with a person she cherished that Makoto made a decision.
lines.zh: 直到和那个她珍视的人一起度过本该是她最后的那段时光，Makoto 才做出了决定。

lines.en: She could keep on living in misery...hoping that things might one day turn around-
lines.zh: 她可以继续痛苦地活下去……指望某天事情会好转 ——

lines.en: Or she could die here on a high note — with the rare tastes of happiness, beauty, and complacency all fresh on her tongue.
lines.zh: 或者她可以在这里、在最高点上死去 —— 舌尖上还留着幸福、美好与满足那几样罕见的滋味。

lines.en: scene bluejay29 with flash
: See you.
lines.zh: : 回见。

lines.en: She made her choice.
lines.zh: 她做出了选择。

But it was wrong.
lines.zh: 但那是错的。

lines.en: scene bluejay36 with flash
: Huh?
So she was given another chance.
lines.zh: 所以她得到了另一次机会。

lines.en: scene meintheroom1 with flash
: That’s something that you and I will never get to have.
lines.zh: : 那是我和你永远都得不到的东西。

lines.en: : If {i}we{/i} die, everything is over.
lines.zh: : 如果{i}我们{/i}死了，一切就都结束了。

lines.en: : We were born in the wrong world.
lines.zh: : 我们生错了世界。

lines.en: : But that’s okay! Because there are hundreds of different faiths with different afterlives that we can pick out of a hat and force ourselves to believe!
lines.zh: : 但这没关系！因为有几百种不同的信仰、各有各的来世，我们可以随便抽一个，然后强迫自己去相信！

lines.en: : Which one do you like the most?
lines.zh: : 你最喜欢哪一个？

lines.en: : Or...are you like me?
lines.zh: : 还是说……你跟我一样？

lines.en: : Too terrified of death to even choose one.
lines.zh: : 怕死怕到连一个都选不出来。

lines.en: scene meintheroom2 with dissolve
: It is at this point that I will, once again, answer some of your questions.
lines.zh: : 到了这里，我又要再一次回答你们的一些问题。

lines.en: : {b}Question 1: {/b}Why was Makoto associated with the Bluejay? Why not another type of bird?
lines.zh: : {b}问题一：{/b}为什么 Makoto 对应的是蓝松鸦？为什么不是别的鸟？

lines.en: : Bird symbolism is something I always enjoy incorporating into Lessons in Love because, to me, there’s nothing more free than a bird. But the world I’ve forced these character into is nothing short of a cage.
lines.zh: : 我一直很喜欢在《Lessons in Love》里加入鸟的意象，因为对我来说，没有什么比鸟更自由。但我把这些角色塞进去的那个世界，简直就是一个笼子。

lines.en: : Having something that is meant to be free confined to a small space it can’t escape from by {i}any{/i} means is just really remarkably powerful to me.
lines.zh: : 把本该自由的东西关在一个它{i}无论如何{/i}都逃不出去的小空间里，这对我来说有着极其强烈的力量。

lines.en: : There are a few different answers to why the Bluejay was assigned to Makoto.
lines.zh: : 至于为什么把蓝松鸦分给 Makoto，有几个不同的答案。

lines.en: : The simplest and most boring of these answers is that blue is simply her favorite color and that there aren’t many birds {i}more{/i} blue than the Bluejay.
lines.zh: : 最简单也最无聊的那个答案是：蓝色就是她最喜欢的颜色，而且没有多少鸟比蓝松鸦{i}更{/i}蓝。

lines.en: : But a more interesting, poetic, and pretentious answer is that the death of a Bluejay has been said to symbolize various things that align with Makoto’s situation.
lines.zh: : 但一个更有趣、更诗意也更矫情的答案是：据说蓝松鸦之死象征着好几样东西，而它们都和 Makoto 的处境吻合。

lines.en: : The first is that there is someone in her life she needs to get rid of.
lines.zh: : 第一，她生命里有一个她需要摆脱的人。

lines.en: : The second is that everything is already beyond repair.
lines.zh: : 第二，一切都已经无法挽回了。

lines.en: : {b}Question 2: {/b}Is this an event you had planned from the beginning? And was it always Makoto?
lines.zh: : {b}问题二：{/b}这个事件是你从一开始就规划好的吗？而且一直都是 Makoto 吗？

lines.en: : Yes and yes. Makoto’s hidden battle with depression was something I always had in mind as I liked its contrast with Rin’s.
lines.zh: : 是，也是。Makoto 与抑郁症的隐秘斗争我一直都记在心里，因为我喜欢它和 Rin 形成的对照。

lines.en: : Makoto succumbing to that was my way of getting across that thing I said earlier about how the visibility of one’s pain doesn’t always equate to how serious it is.
lines.zh: : 让 Makoto 屈服于此，是我表达前面那句话的方式 —— 一个人的痛苦有多外露，并不总等于它有多严重。

lines.en: : Makoto pushes herself harder than anyone else in the game, and the only two people she has to fall back on feel more like children that she needs to take care of.
lines.zh: : Makoto 逼自己逼得比游戏里任何人都狠，而她仅有的两个可以依靠的人，感觉更像是她需要照顾的孩子。

lines.en: : That brand of loneliness just becomes too much for her to bear one day and she gives in.
lines.zh: : 那种孤独有一天终于超出了她能承受的限度，于是她屈服了。

lines.en: : {b}Question 3: {/b}How did you expect the community to react to the event and did it live up to your expectations?
lines.zh: : {b}问题三：{/b}你预期玩家社区会怎么反应？结果达到你的预期了吗？

lines.en: : I honestly think the initial community-wide reaction to Bluejay is my favorite reaction the Discord server has ever had.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得大家对《Bluejay》最初的、整个社区范围内的反应，是 Discord 服务器有史以来我最喜欢的一次。

lines.en: : There were a ton of people who made it to the event at the same exact time, so there was just a flood of disbelief and shock that was utterly astonishing to watch.
lines.zh: : 有一大群人在同一时间玩到了这个事件，于是难以置信和震惊像潮水一样涌来，看着实在令人惊叹。

lines.en: : Getting people to {i}feel{/i} something is the ultimate mark of effective writing. And so having a ton of people feeling things {i}together{/i} at {i}one time{/i} is extremely special for a creator.
lines.zh: : 能让人{i}感受到{/i}什么，是写作有效的最高标志。所以，让一大群人在{i}同一时刻{/i}{i}一起{/i}感受到什么，对一个创作者来说极其特别。

lines.en: : I do hope that I’ll be able to get that level of satisfaction out of another reaction some day. It was wonderful.
lines.zh: : 我真希望有一天还能从另一次反应里得到那种程度的满足。那感觉棒极了。

lines.en: : {b}This next question will contain spoilers for Chapter 3. Please skip it if you are not caught up with the game.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}下一个问题包含第三章剧透。如果你还没玩到这里，请跳过。{/b}

lines.en: : {b}Question 4: {/b} Was the death of Makoto’s father already planned when you wrote Bluejay? And if he never died, would she still feel this way?
lines.zh: : {b}问题四：{/b}你写《Bluejay》的时候，Makoto 父亲的死已经规划好了吗？如果他没死，她还会这样吗？

lines.en: : Yes and absolutely. There is an extreme difference between Depression the disorder and just...{i}being{/i} depressed.
lines.zh: : 是，绝对会。「抑郁症」这种病，和只是……{i}感到{/i}抑郁，两者之间有极大的区别。

lines.en: : The death of Makoto’s father causes her a great deal of pain and sort of chemically reacts with her Depression, but that disorder is always going to {i}be{/i} there — even {i}with{/i} help.
lines.zh: : Makoto 父亲的死给她带来巨大的痛苦，并且和她的抑郁症产生了某种化学反应，但那个病{i}一直{/i}会在那里 —— 就算{i}有{/i}帮助也一样。

lines.en: : So, as far as I’m concerned, the fate of Makoto’s father and her overwhelming feeling like everything is just useless really aren’t linked at all.
lines.zh: : 所以在我看来，Makoto 父亲的命运，和她那种「一切都没有意义」的压倒性感受，其实根本没有关联。

lines.en: : {b}Final Question: {/b}How significant were the events of the first Halloween party to Bluejay?
lines.zh: : {b}最后一个问题：{/b}第一次万圣节派对那些事对《Bluejay》有多重要？

lines.en: : Extremely significant, actually. It’s still present in the revamped version of the game but, originally, there was an even greater deal of emphasis placed on Makoto’s pursuit of her defloration.
lines.zh: : 其实极其重要。它在重制版里仍然存在，但原本，Makoto 追求「破处」这件事被强调得还要更重。

lines.en: : She is a girl who yearns for something to make her feel whole — to make her feel like she has a purpose.
lines.zh: : 她是一个渴望着某样东西、好让自己觉得完整的女孩 —— 好让自己觉得自己有意义。

lines.en: : And so she sees this man who she respects...and she falls for him only to have him take advantage of those feelings and coerce her into a sexual relationship shortly after.
lines.zh: : 于是她看着这个她尊敬的男人……爱上了他，结果他却利用这份感情，没多久就哄着她成了性关系。

lines.en: : And as she grows closer to him, she realizes this endless onslaught of sexual favors isn’t enough. It’s not making her feel {i}anything{/i} on an emotional level.
lines.zh: : 而随着她和他越来越亲近，她意识到这种没完没了的性根本不够。它并没有在情感的层面上让她感受到{i}任何东西{/i}。

lines.en: : But if she can just connect with that person in the most intimate way possible...maybe, {i}maybe{/i} then there’s a chance for that to change.
lines.zh: : 但如果她能和那个人以最亲密的方式相连……也许，{i}也许{/i}那样就有机会改变。

lines.en: : But then she does.
lines.zh: : 然后她做到了。

lines.en: : And it doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 而它并没有改变。

lines.en: : And she realizes once again while covered in blood and cum in a dark room that there is no sensation that can make her sadness go away.
lines.zh: : 而她再一次明白了 —— 在那个昏暗的房间里，浑身是血和精液 —— 没有任何感觉能让她的悲伤消失。

lines.en: : And it all spirals from there.
lines.zh: : 然后一切就从那里开始失控。

lines.zh: 感谢你抽出时间阅读 Makoto Miyamura 事件《Bluejay》的场景解说。

lines.en: Stick around and continue showing your support for more scenes just like this in the future.
lines.zh: 请继续关注，并继续支持未来更多像这样的场景。

lines.zh: Selebus，下线。
